output.reason: The release note on its own is vague [ev-86fbebcd5678], but the linked PRs and issue make it concrete. The subject is the UI YAML editor component (ui/src/app/shared/components/yaml-editor/yaml-editor.tsx) [ev-4aff389248bc][ev-843cd284d60f]. The change reverts #21064, which split arrays in the YAML view to fix ambiguous collapse [ev-286b271e2461][ev-361fb7d5faa3]. That split caused extra newlines after each "-" list item, and editing and saving a manifest then produced malformed YAML [ev-0e6920082e99][ev-088a5858fcca][ev-361fb7d5faa3]. So the consequence is a UI-only fix that restores the earlier rendering, with no operator action needed. The issue reports the regression on a master build, which suggests it never shipped in an earlier release [ev-088a5858fcca].
